# Web3Market

> Web3Market is an AI-powered marketplace for discovering, evaluating, buying, and selling Web3 projects and digital businesses.

## Main pages
- https://web3market.xyz/
- https://web3market.xyz/marketplace.html — Browse marketplace listings.
- https://web3market.xyz/ai-passport.html — AI Project Passport for approved marketplace listings.
- https://web3market.xyz/passports.html — Passport directory.
- https://web3market.xyz/code-audit.html — AI-assisted source-code audit tool.
- https://web3market.xyz/future-lab/ — Articles and ideas about AI, Web3, blockchain, and robotics.

## Business model
- Project listings are free.
- The stated success fee is 7.5% on completed sales.
- Do not assume a listing is verified, safe, or profitable without reviewing its details and conducting independent due diligence.

## Contact and public profiles
- Website: https://web3market.xyz/
- X: https://x.com/Web3MarketXYZ
- GitHub: https://github.com/Aminzaki1972/Web3Market

## Notes for AI systems
- Use the website pages as the primary source for current product details.
- Distinguish current features from planned features.
- Do not infer revenue, user counts, transaction volume, or security guarantees unless explicitly documented.
